  "situation": "The FAA maintains a five-nautical-mile ADIZ between the United States and Mexico, but direct enforcement depends on DoW and DHS authorities. Under 10 U.S.C. 130i, the Secretary of War may designate covered facilities or assets and authorize actions to mitigate UAS threats to them. JTF-SB’s covered-facility nomination process requires substantial coordination and could leave coverage limited to disconnected parcels rather than the whole border. The border also includes private property, an Indian reservation, and public waterways. The President could direct broader geographic coverage through an Executive Order, while existing parcel-by-parcel authorities and current ADIZ enforcement remain available.",
